title: 5.1 The Internet and the World Wide Web
description: The Internet and the World Wide Web: definition, history, protocols, DNS, URLs and websites. Medium level, 20 questions.

questions.question: Which statement distinguishes the Internet from the World Wide Web?
options: The Web is an information service built on the Internet
The Internet is a collection of linked web pages worldwide
The Web is the physical network of computers
They are two different names for the same global system
questions.correctAnswer: The Web is an information service built on the Internet

questions.question: What role does IP play in data transmission?
options: It addresses packets and chooses the route they take
It guarantees that packets arrive in the correct order
It encrypts all data before network transmission
It stores web pages on a remote web server
questions.correctAnswer: It addresses packets and chooses the route they take

questions.question: What does TCP add to the service provided by IP?
options: Reliable, ordered delivery of data
Faster routing of packets
Encryption of all traffic
Unique addressing of all network devices
questions.correctAnswer: Reliable, ordered delivery of data

questions.question: What is the first step of the TCP three-way handshake?
options: Computer A sends a SYN message
Computer B sends a SYN-ACK reply
Computer A sends an ACK message
Both computers exchange FIN messages
questions.correctAnswer: Computer A sends a SYN message

questions.question: Which TCP feature numbers every byte of data?
options: Sequence numbers
Acknowledgments
Flow control
Congestion control
questions.correctAnswer: Sequence numbers

questions.question: What does the sender do when an acknowledgment times out?
options: The sender retransmits the missing data
The receiver closes the TCP connection immediately
The router changes the IP address
The browser renders the page again
questions.correctAnswer: The sender retransmits the missing data

questions.question: Which statement about IP is accurate?
options: It delivers packets on a best-effort basis
It guarantees delivery of every packet
It reorders packets at the destination
It establishes a connection before sending
questions.correctAnswer: It delivers packets on a best-effort basis

questions.question: What is the purpose of flow control in TCP?
options: To prevent the sender from overwhelming the receiver
To slow down the sender when the network becomes busy
To number every byte in each data segment sent
To close the connection politely after transfer
questions.correctAnswer: To prevent the sender from overwhelming the receiver

questions.question: Which service acts like the Internet’s phone book?
options: DNS
FTP
SMTP
HTTP
questions.correctAnswer: DNS

questions.question: What does the DNS resolver do first after a user types a URL?
options: It queries a DNS root name server
It queries the domain’s name server
It sends an HTTP request to the site
It contacts the web server directly
questions.correctAnswer: It queries a DNS root name server

questions.question: Which server returns the IP address of a domain in a DNS lookup?
options: The domain’s name server
The root name server
The top-level domain server
The web server
questions.correctAnswer: The domain’s name server

questions.question: In a URL, what do the key-value pairs after a question mark represent?
options: URL query parameters
The top-level domain of the site
The subdomain before the first dot
The path to a specific web page
questions.correctAnswer: URL query parameters

questions.question: Which part of a URL is ".com" in "www.example.com"?
options: The top-level domain
The subdomain www
The protocol scheme
The slug of the web page
questions.correctAnswer: The top-level domain

questions.question: What does HTTPS add to HTTP?
options: SSL/TLS encryption of the data
Faster delivery of web pages
A new request method
Automatic translation of pages
questions.correctAnswer: SSL/TLS encryption of the data

questions.question: Which methods are commonly used by HTTP requests?
options: GET and POST
SYN and ACK
SMTP and POP3
FTP and DNS
questions.correctAnswer: GET and POST

questions.question: What is a static website?
options: A site whose content stays the same until edited
A site built with server-side scripting
A site that generates pages on the fly
A site that personalizes content for each visitor
questions.correctAnswer: A site whose content stays the same until edited

questions.question: Which scripting languages are mentioned for dynamic websites?
options: PHP, Python and Node.js
HTML, CSS and JavaScript
SQL, XML and JSON
C, C++ and Java
questions.correctAnswer: PHP, Python and Node.js

questions.question: Which web server software is named in the text?
options: Apache and Nginx
Chrome and Firefox
MySQL and MariaDB
Windows and Linux
questions.correctAnswer: Apache and Nginx

questions.question: What is the client-server model of the Web?
options: Servers deliver pages to clients on request
Clients store pages for servers to read
Servers request pages from other servers
Browsers act as servers for other web pages
questions.correctAnswer: Servers deliver pages to clients on request

questions.question: Which step comes immediately after a browser performs a DNS lookup?
options: The browser sends an HTTP request to the server
The browser renders the HTML page on the screen
The server returns a DNS answer
The user clicks a hyperlink on the page
questions.correctAnswer: The browser sends an HTTP request to the server
